create_Version_instance: create a Version object from a version string like '1.2.3' or '1.2.3-dev'
get_pep440_version: get a PEP440-compliant version string from a Version instance for Python packaging
get_ruby_version: get a Ruby-style version string from a Version instance with four-part formatting
get_php_pecl_version: get a PHP PECL version string from a Version instance with dev or RC tags
run_mako_plugin: run the mako_plugin function to expand version strings for all supported languages in settings
